messages:
Asha (Partnerships): Heads-up: demo collab with LangChain + LlamaIndex + an orchestration tool for Summit on Sept 12. Need runway for joint announcement + marketplace listing. Who can own the tech side?
Rafael (Partner Eng): I can take lead on adapter validation. Need specs for dataflow and any extra auth modes.
Riley (Eng-Platform): Happy to build demo infra. Can we get a sample prompt set and expected latency SLOs? Also, any HW partner KPIs? @Tao
Tao (HW Partnerships): Will check with SigmaCloud for reserved GPUs for demo day. Can commit N+1 for ~2 hours. Need list of image sizes and perf targets.
Marta (DevEx): I'll build the quickstart repo + runnable tutorial. Suggest we use a minimal docker image and a single pipeline for the orchestration demo.
Asha (Partnerships): Plan: three short demos — 1) retrieval + chain using LlamaIndex, 2) LangChain agents calling tools through our gateway, 3) orchestration failover (primary -> fallback) to show graceful degradation. Each ~3-4 min. Owners: retrieval=Rafael, agents=Marta, failover=Riley.
Rafael (Partner Eng): Noted. For retrieval demo I will prepare a 1k-doc sample (product FAQs) and share the LlamaIndex pipeline + embedding config. No real customer data (will synthesize).
Marta (DevEx): Tutorial will include repo, terraform for sandbox, and a 1-click deploy script. Proposed command snippet:
```bash
./deploy-demo.sh --partner langchain --region us-west-2
```
Riley (Eng-Platform): For the failover demo I'll wire a routing policy: primary = redwood-hosted gptx-large, fallback = local quantized distil. Will add tracing so we can show latency and cost deltas live.
Kai (Sales): I'll coordinate announcement messaging and partner comms. Need a short customer-facing summary + joint logos. Marketing: @Sophie to own co-marketing assets.
Sophie (Marketing): Got it. Need partner logo assets, cert language, and a joint quote. Can we lock creative by Aug 25?
Asha (Partnerships): Timeline check: Tech dry-run Aug 20, Creative lock Aug 25, Internal dress rehearsal Sept 5, Summit Sept 12. Can everyone confirm blockers?
Tao (HW Partnerships): GPU booking pending (ETA Wed). Also need compliance sign-off for demo datasets — are we OK to scrub PII? Rafael?
Rafael (Partner Eng): I'll produce a scrubbed synthetic dataset, no PII. Also running adapter conformance tests now — will post pass/fail in this thread.
DevBot (CI): CI: demo repo scaffold created at https://github.com/redwood/demo-isv-summit (created by DevBot). Tests added: adapter-lint, e2e-smoke.
Marta (DevEx): :thumbsup: I'll point the quickstart at that repo. Do we want a "Redwood-Verified" badge for marketplace listing?
Asha (Partnerships): Yes — marketplace badge is desirable. Product should define criteria (SLA, test pass threshold). @Riley can you produce the perf report for verification?
Riley (Eng-Platform): Will run perf matrix and generate a heatmap + report by Aug 18.
Kai (Sales): Sales request: include a short partner playbook (one-pager) for field. I'll draft and share by Aug 30.
Sophie (Marketing): One more ask: a 60s customer-facing video showing the end-to-end flow. Who can record? Rafael + Marta maybe?
Rafael (Partner Eng): We can record a screenshare walkthrough. I'll coordinate scheduling.
Asha (Partnerships): Awesome — action items summarized. I'll drop a follow-up doc with owners + deadlines. Thanks team :rocket:
